obligations: `Modal` conforms to `ModalInterface` (`host`, `shown`, `show`, `hide`, `toggle`, `update`, `destroy`): construction validates the host, resolves the groups and the options (`backdrop` and `dismiss.backdrop` both from the `backdrop` attribute through a `parseBackdrop` reader in `parsers.ts` that reads `true`, `false`, and `static`, the constructor's `backdrop` and `dismiss` winning; `dismiss.escape` from the `escape` attribute (`data-bs-keyboard`); `focus` from `focus`), finds the dialog through `dialog`, claims the host, binds the hooks and the host's own `keydown` Escape and `mousedown` then `click` light-dismiss listeners; `show(relatedTarget?)` refuses (`false`, no event) when shown or in flight, dispatches the cancelable `show.vn.modal` with `detail.relatedTarget`, refuses on prevention, locks scrolling through `ScrollLock`, adds `open` (`modal-open`) to the body, shows the `Backdrop` when `backdrop` is true, appends the host to the body when detached, writes `display: block`, removes `aria-hidden`, writes `aria-modal="true"` and `role="dialog"`, zeros the host's and body's scroll, reflows, adds `shown`, waits through `settleAnimations` on the dialog when the host carries `fade`, isolates the rest of the document through `Isolation` when `focus` is true and moves focus into the host, dispatches `shown.vn.modal`, resolves `true`; `hide` mirrors it (`hide.vn.modal`, the isolation released, `shown` removed, the wait, `display: none`, `aria-hidden="true"`, `aria-modal` and `role` removed, the backdrop hidden and removed, `open` removed and the scroll lock released when this modal was the last, `hidden.vn.modal`); Escape with `dismiss.escape` true hides, otherwise dispatches `prevent.vn.modal` and applies the `static` token to the host until the dialog's transition settles; a `mousedown` then `click` on the host itself with `backdrop` true hides when `dismiss.backdrop` is true and runs the `prevent` path otherwise; `update` recomputes the scrollbar compensation; `destroy` abandons a transition, releases the backdrop, the lock, and the isolation, and restores through `HostSnapshot`. Every write through a door read; proofs with mutations, including R17's `focus: false` (no isolation, no focus move) and E13's overlapping restoration bound recorded where it appears.

`Backdrop` (`src/browser/Backdrop.ts`, R8): appends a `div` carrying the `backdrop` token (`modal-backdrop`) and `fade` when animated to the body, reflows, adds `shown`, waits through `settleAnimations`; hiding removes `shown`, waits, and removes the node; it never promotes to the top layer. `ScrollLock` (`src/browser/ScrollLock.ts`, R8): a class-static reference count writes `overflow: hidden` on the body and the scrollbar width as padding-right on the body and on `.fixed-top`, `.fixed-bottom`, `.is-fixed`, `.sticky-top` (margin-right on `.sticky-top`), through one `HostSnapshot`, and restores when the count returns to zero. `Isolation` (`src/browser/Isolation.ts`, R8): writes `inert` on every sibling of the host's ancestor chain outside the host (and the backdrop), records and restores focus, and releases on hide and destroy. Proofs for each on Chromium 153, reading computed styles, `inert` behaviour through focus attempts, and the reference count across two modals.

The delegate's modal routes (R5): a click on `[data-bs-toggle="modal"]` resolves the modal through `readTarget`, prevents an anchor's default, hides an open modal inside the root first (Bootstrap's data API), calls `show(trigger)`, and returns focus to the trigger after `hidden.vn.modal` when the show was not prevented; the dismiss route for `modal` through the shared dismiss resolution (where J-ALERT has not landed when you write, write it in your unit's shape and report the duplicate). Proofs in `Delegate.test.ts`.

`isModalEvent` narrows the detail shape (`relatedTarget` optional); the `MODAL_EVENTS`, `MODAL_CLASSES`, `MODAL_ATTRIBUTES`, `MODAL_SELECTORS`, and `MODAL_DEFAULTS` tables are frozen; `parseBackdrop` in `parsers.ts` with tests; the barrel and export list grow.
